ios.desc:
▶ Track crypto and dollar prices in real time
Real-time prices for the dollar, stablecoins and major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ether.

▶ Crypto widgets, coin tracker & L2 fees
Track dollar prices and different exchange rates, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins on the most relevant exchanges, all directly from your home screen or lock screen widgets. Real-time quotes.
ETH gas tracker widget including Ethereum L2 and sidechains fees.

▶ Crypto yields on DeFi and CeFi - APY Widgets
Track the APYs on DeFi Protocols, ETH restaking on L2 and CeFi exchanges on the different blockchains. Ability to track the tokens on the Home screen widgets.

▶ P2P Exchanges
Possibility to view rates on P2P exchanges.

▶ Filters
Sort exchanges by: buy, sell, spread.
Hide unwanted exchanges.

▶ Exchanges sorted by best price Including commissions
Find the best exchange rates for your operations. Arbolito helps you identify opportunities in the market by showing you where to get the best price for your cryptocurrencies. Sort exchanges by: buy, sell, spread.

▶ Support for the currencies of the following countries:
- Argentine Peso
- Brazilian Real
- Chilean Peso
- Colombian Peso
- Mexican Peso
- Peruvian Sol
- Uruguayan Peso
- Venezuelan Bolivar

▶ Price of Bitcoin and Ethereum in dollars.
BTC and ETH price widgets in US dollars, available for both the main and the lock screens.

▶ No advertising, analytics or creepy tracking of any kind.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made a crypto DeFi yield tracking in 3 days

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

An iOS dev trying his best to make a living as solopreneur. The mission for this year is to launch 12 iOS apps.

This app started by a tweet as there were lots people trying to display crypto widgets on the iOS homescreen by following 5 steps which included downloading an app, adding a script, editing, etc.

So after quoting that tweet and asking if were any interest for an app instead, I ended up building and releasing arbolito app to the AppStore in just 3 days.

The first version included dollar rates in Argentina (yes, we have multiple exchange rates for the dollar, it's crazy) and stablecoins/btc/eth prices in pesos for all the LA CEXs. Later added more countries and CeFi yields.

A week ago I've released L2 fees widgets with the gas/txs fees for Ethereum L2 and sidechains.

Finally, a couple of days ago, I've launched a DeFi APYs tracking by chain (including Widget). So far it supports the most well known protocols on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optismim, Polygon, Gnosis and Avalanche.

ps: It's free, no ads, no sign-ups, no tracking, no creepy stuff, etc.

I hope you like arbolito. Would love your feedback please. Thanks.

Pablo
